race.title: Shloer Chase (Registered As The Cheltenham Chase) (Grade 2) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: A typically small field for this year's Shloer Chase and it's hard to get away from JONBON , who bids for a third success in the race and had bottomless ground as an excuse for his below-par second last year. Fragility remains an ongoing problem for Gidleigh Park , but he can provide most resistance if returning on his A-game, with the race-fit Saint Segal taken to fill out third. JONBON (FR) GIDLEIGH PARK SAINT SEGAL (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Jonbon (10/11), Gidleigh Park (3/1), Saint Segal (9/2), Mighty Bandit (7/1)
